name: smwmusic-remove-kebab-chrono-trigger-style
title: Remove Kebab (Chrono Trigger Style)
description:
The meme song we all know and love, using most of the instruments from the Guardia Millenial Fair from Chrono Trigger. Also known as Serbia Strong.

Good for title screens and cutscenes. Also overworlds too maybe.

(btw yes, this is a serious meme port, before anyone asks)
